questions.question: What did Moses ask the people to bring for building the tabernacle?
options: Freewill offerings of materials and skilled work
A fixed tax collected from every tribe
Animals and grain for the daily morning sacrifices
Silver redeemed from each firstborn son
questions.answer: Freewill offerings of materials and skilled work

questions.question: What command did Moses repeat about the seventh day?
options: To keep the Sabbath as a day of rest
To fast from all food for seven days
To offer a sacrifice every morning
To set out on the journey at dawn
questions.answer: To keep the Sabbath as a day of rest

questions.question: The people gave so willingly that their hearts stirred them to bring offerings.
Whoever was of a willing _____ brought the LORD's offering.
On the seventh day there was to be a holy day of _____ to the LORD.
